paper.title: Algorithm 451: Chi-square quantiles
paper.venue: Communications of the ACM 16(8), 483-485 (1973); collected as ACM TOMS Algorithm 451
paper.note: ACM article not read; the authors' Fortran (netlib TOMS 451.gz, sha256 checked) was run.

stack: Fortran 77-style single precision (REAL) sources from netlib TOMS 451; built with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 (conda-forge) in the sandbox

claim.text: CHISQD(P, N) at P = 0.5, N = 10 (Chi-square quantile, single precision), as printed by the authors' driver. Registered tolerance: abs 1e-5.

attempt: Ran the authors' Fortran/Sp/Drivers/driver.f and src.f (unpacked verbatim from the archive, no source edit) with gfortran -O2 in the sandbox. Two passes, each in a fresh run directory with the same binary, print 9.341793 for the computed CHISQD(0.5,10). Difference from the claim 9.341794: 1e-6, inside tol 1e-5.

original_attempt.reason: The authors' Drivers/Makefile calls f77, which is not installed in the sandbox (make: f77: No such file or directory). A retry with the same Makefile and F77=gfortran (compiler name only, no source or flag change) builds and runs; that retry is recorded as the build above, so the basis is patched.
